[animovement]{.hero-eyebrow}

::: {.hero-lead}
An R toolbox for analysing movement across space and time.
:::

Install *animovement* with:

```r
install.packages(
  "animovement",
  repos = c(
    "https://animovement.r-universe.dev",
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```
:::
::::
:::::

::: {.landing-section}

## A modular workflow for movement analysis

A collection of R packages for every stage of movement analysis — for
ethologists, behavioural ecologists, neuroscientists, and anyone else who
needs to make sense of how animals move.

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature}
[]{.feature-icon .bi .bi-database}

### Read from anywhere

Support for video-based tracking tools such as *DeepLabCut*, *SLEAP* and
*idtracker.ai*, plus hardware-based data from trackballs.

[VERSATILE]{.feature-pill}
:::

::: {.feature}
[]{.feature-icon .bi .bi-arrow-repeat}

### Flexible toolkit

A *tidyverse*-friendly suite of modular packages that form one unified
workflow. Start with the piece you need, add others as challenges arise.

[MODULAR]{.feature-pill}
:::

::: {.feature}
[]{.feature-icon .bi .bi-shield-check}

### Thoroughly tested

Every package uses *testthat* and *codecov* so the code is thoroughly tested
and you can trust your findings.

[TRUSTED]{.feature-pill}
:::
:::

## The packages

*animovement* is an ecosystem of R packages, each solving one stage of the
workflow. [Browse them all →](packages/index.qmd)

::: {.package-grid}
[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-box}[aniframe]{.package-name}[Core data structures]{.package-role}[S3 classes for representing and manipulating movement data.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/aniframe){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-download}[aniread]{.package-name}[Reading & writing]{.package-role}[Read and write movement data from diverse sources.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/aniread){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-clipboard-check}[anicheck]{.package-name}[Data quality]{.package-role}[Diagnose missing values, temporal gaps and spatial outliers.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/anicheck){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-gear}[aniprocess]{.package-name}[Processing & filtering]{.package-role}[Filter, smooth and process movement trajectories.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/aniprocess){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-bar-chart}[animetric]{.package-name}[Metrics]{.package-role}[Kinematics, navigational statistics and social measures.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/animetric){.package-card}

[[]{.package-badge .bi .bi-graph-up}[anivis]{.package-name}[Visualization]{.package-role}[Publication-ready plots of trajectories, diagnostics and metrics.]{.package-desc}](https://animovement.dev/anivis){.package-card}
:::
